To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

social media is a powerful tool for connecting people, and that the perceived ease of use of social media and the perceived usefulness of social media are two major influencers of individuals’ intention to adopt social media.
the individuals’ perceived connected and perceived enjoyment are the major stimuli for their social networking sites adoption intention.
perceived connectedness and enjoyment are the key determinants of social media adoption, and perceived usefulness, and ease of use mediate the relationship.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the adoption of social media in Saudi Arabia.
the theoretical model and empirical evidence for social media adoption.
the theoretical model and the empirical evidence of the social media adoption by individuals.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
social media adoption intention is influenced by individuals’ perceived enjoyment, perceived connectedness and their perceived ease of use.
social media adoption is a complex process and it is influenced by multiple variables and the relationships among them.
the social media adoption is driven by the individuals’ perceived connectednes and perceived enjoyment.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
social media has become an essential part of our life.
the social media adoption intention of the youth is determined by their perceived connectedness and their enjoyment of social media.
the social media adoption is a function of the perceived connectedness and enjoyment, which are influenced by the ease of use and usefulness of the social media.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the social media designers and developers should focus on the perceived enjoyment and the connectedness to increase the social media adoption intention among the individuals.
social media adoption intention is influenced by various factors and the designers/developers should take into consideration these factors to make the social media more appealing for the users.
social media adoption is a complex phenomenon and it requires a holistic approach to be understood.
